notes.title: Update 1.2_04 is live!
notes.content:
A new update for Wave Rider has been released. This update includes bugfixes, UI improvements and physics tweaks. Here's the list of changes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38804999/739bad0b8f0d28ec5926b26085cba666da667d67.png[/img]
[b]Fullscreen mode & resolution[/b] [i](Huge thanks to cosstab for reporting this bug!)[/i]
[list]
[*] Revised Alt+Enter behavior; It now switches between window modes without resetting your resolution.
[*] Removed leftover code from the old resolution cycle button.
[*] Fullscreen toggle in options menu now accurately reflects current window state.
[*] Resolutions are now listed from higher to lower.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38804999/6de75f6d2a5f09c1b400755c7b4a2ede72312751.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38804999/c8650c90bb4dcf2fb41a9e0138f0c7593f01a920.png[/img][/url]
[*] Switching scenes no longer resets your screen settings.
[*] Basically, a lot of things that acted weirdly were fixed.
[/list]
[b]UI Additions[/b]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38804999/2294776c665de08be25bf74ba20ef5b9081cc095.gif[/img]
[*] Added a steering angle indicator.
[list]
[*] The polarity icons (-/+) point you towards your next wave recharge.
[*] The polarity icons and waves bar glow when you perform a recharge.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38804999/4df556c257519fcb01e3731a4ebd625a3ec575a0.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38804999/4df556c257519fcb01e3731a4ebd625a3ec575a0.gif[/img][/url]
[/list]
[*] Pause menu can now be accessed during "The Choice".
[*] Fixed music and sound volume slider ranges being unbalanced.
[/list]
[b]Physics[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed anti-drift compensation being enabled during intentional drifts. (Yes, really.)
[*] Fixed a bug where fully countersteering was impossible during drifts.
[*] Edited drift sound to be a seamless loop.
[*] Reduced camera offset when drifting.
[*] Gear shift sounds are back.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38804999/22b8712f7ab135ea38e357c69dbaa23710ea20ca.gif[/img]

As always, thank you for playing, and have fun!
[url=https://discord.gg/FhQh2BuPJ2]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Update 1.2_03 is live!
notes.content:
A new update for Wave Rider has been released. This update includes changes for some achievements and the Saturna stage.

[b]Saturna[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a wall at the end to guide the player to the stage exit.
[*] Fixed a stutter issue towards the end of the stage.
[*] Removed instakill wall, replaced with a regular wall.
[*] Traffic cars no longer despawn when they reach the end of their path.
[/list]
[b]Achievements[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new (provisional) beta branch with the [b]legacy[/b] version of the game. You can use this to get the Hardcore mode achievements until Hardcore mode is restored in the post-rewrite version of the game.
[*] Fixed the "Nice ride!" achievement.
[list]
[*] The achievement has been restored.
[*] Take the original four riders to the end once.
[*] Pick whatever stage you like the most.[/list]
[/list]
Once again, thank you for playing. Have fun!

notes.title: Update 1.2_02 is live!
notes.content:
A new update for Wave Rider has been released. This update includes primarily UI changes, bug fixes and some game feel improvements.

Join the community at our [url=https://discord.gg/54vKTBHr37]Discord Server[/url] and share your thoughts!

[b]New![/b]
[list]
[*] Your times are now displayed in the stage select screen.
[*] Completion percentages for sprint races.
[*] Lap and sector times are shown on screen.
[*] New camera and visual effects.
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the lighting in the final stage wouldn't show properly.
[*] Fixed collision maps for the tutorial race.
[*] Fixed a bug where brakes would not work if the throttle was applied.
[*] Fixed a bug where the wrong car would spawn in the last scene.
[*] Fixed a bug where the screen resolution would not be saved after leaving the options menu.
[*] Restored introductory scene and stage unlocks.
[*] And many, many more...
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes v1.2_01
notes.content:
[b]Hello![/b]
A new patch for Wave Rider has been released. Here's some of the changes that were made:

[b]New![/b]
[list]
[*] A new music mode: A e s t h e t i c. Find it under the Audio options menu!
[*] Cutscenes can be skipped by holding certain buttons (Pause, Accept, Cancel, etc...)
[*] On-screen text for countdowns and player-started races
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38804999/870a07e7c6cec467ad32225f5af4fe3733e3217c.png[/img]

[b]Time control changes[/b]
[list]
[*] The time control skill will hold itself active for a brief time to communicate its functionality better
[*] Time control uses a less invasive screen effect
[*] Wave Energy drain has been decreased (3 -> 2)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38804999/d22fecf03680901626e13a63a45633a3ad20fdbf.png[/img]

[b]Major bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] The tutorial race can now be completed normally!
[*] The WR Mini minigame button is now in the main menu by default and will load the minigame as intended
[*] Jumps and wall crawls in the Tutorial map have been removed
[/list]
[b]Other improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Reflections in the Tutorial map are fixed
[*] Labels in the options menu now have outlines for better readability
[*] The subtitles in the Tutorial have been placed at the bottom of the screen
[*] Increased camera shake when landing a jump
[*] The boost tunnel in the tutorial no longer requires the player to be boosting through it
[*] Antialiasing toggle fixed
[*] Reduced clutter from checkpoint messages
[/list]

Have fun!
-Daniel

notes.title: Wave Rider version 1.2 is live! + Discord server
notes.content:
A new update for Wave Rider is now live! This update includes many changes and bug fixes to the game, as well as a new rider, the Xenon 3!

Join the community at our [url=https://discord.gg/FhQh2BuPJ2][b]Discord[/b][/url] server and share your thoughts!

Some of the changes this update brings:
[list]
[*] Several map changes and optimizations
[*] Rebuilt drift mechanics
[*] Checkpoint and lap counters next to the timer
[*] Resolution and frame rate drop-down menus
[*] A better post-race results screen with checkpoint times
[*] New jumping behaviors
[*] Sound mixing balance and some new sound effects
[*] Races now start automatically with a countdown effect
[*] Smooth transitions between scenes
[*] Dynamic checkpoint timing
[*] Fixed clipping issues around Hydroway
[*] Other UI Improvements and fixes
[*] And many, many under-the-hood system rewrites and fixes
[/list]
We hope you enjoy this update! Much work was put into streamlining both the user experience and our content creation process. Stay tuned for even more stunning maps with exciting races and even faster riders coming soon!

notes.title: Patch Update 1.1
notes.content:
Hey there! Merry Christmas! I hope everyone is enjoying the game. We just uploaded a quick patch addressing some bugs.

- Added skip credits. (press any button!)
- Fixed hardcore achievement (it will be unlocked in the main menu, if it doesn't and you already beaten the hardcore mode, you will have to do it again, sorry!)
- Fixed hardcore highscore label not showing.
- Reduced how much scraping the wall slows you down.
